answer: Prayers & Duties >> Sawm (Fasting) Question ID: 2714 Country: India Title: Is it allowed to brush one's teeth with toothpaste during roza/fast (ramazan)? Question: Is it allowed to brush one's teeth with toothpaste during roza/fast (ramazan)? Answer ID: 2714 Posted on: Aug 31, 2020 Bismillah hir-Rahman nir-Rahim ! (Fatwa: 68/59=D) It is utterly disliked; if some part of it reached to the throat the fast will be nullified. Allah (Subhana Wa Ta'ala) knows Best Darul Ifta, Darul Uloom Deoband, India
